## 2026-11-15：BatchRenamer 三个原生双端交互场景校准

继承已确认的零像素差异、SSIM≥0.999999999、关键样式/矩形差异0及源warning/error阻断口径；旧草案、确认记录、组件与分数不改。三个独立默认场景：原生输入prefix=img/startAt=3，预览隐藏→恢复，编辑后应用规则并验证apply载荷。

1对组件、3场景、6原生页面、两端14次操作；10对画面检查均零像素/样式/矩形差异，20单端状态/事件/可见DOM检查一致；最终52个DOM事件isTrusted为true。应用后文件名为img-3.png/img-4.png/img-5.png，两端各一次apply事件，其payload与内部currentFiles在发出时不是同一引用；只证明该根数组复制，不外推深层别名或外部监听器语义。

原动作器不支持文本编辑，故另建v2的可见可编辑text/number输入支持：原生Ctrl+A与Input.insertText、读回校验，不注入value、不调用业务方法或dispatchEvent；仅非空、≤80字符ASCII及界内正整数，不覆盖清空/IME/小数/任意步长。新被动事件身份观察和可选DOM集合记录表格真正消失与恢复；业务源码/默认值/CSS不改。schema5与旧3/4分开，生产分派和旧反馈器未接入，不冒充综合迁移门。

4对合成控制/8页：正常替换通过；故意输出加!分别检测43/33像素差异；源console.warn即使画面相同仍阻断；只读输入被拒绝，保留initial和后续not_run。它们不计入组件样本通过率。两次本步浏览器启动共14页；20个可比检查点的PNG解码/指标独立重算一致。上步音量浏览器不重跑，复核其保存证据和旧测试，不能当作新原生运行。

最终249/249定向测试（本步25+音量23+历史草案46+原生反馈90+会话53+动态键12），非全仓库；变异测试同步伪造首帧与重复观察，错误仍由语义/身份断言拒绝，而不只靠重复快照漂移。93旧相关文件、3人工配置、4参考、6冻结SFC、30对当前/历史主Vue、上步105payload与closeout不变；旧24/30/失败6/token1,821,544不回填。原143单元及metadata保留，只追加本节和只读核验；JSON和代码编译/新单元执行不等于Notebook UI渲染或新增人工组件通过。

报告技能用于区分自动场景校准、预期失败控制和remaining_risk，不计为新的生产缺陷率或人工确认。仍不证明任意公开键、其他props/异常输入、通知/异常、任意监听器等完整等价；字体二进制/完整传递依赖未冻结，CDP trace不认证任意外部生产者。模型/新增人工/commit/push均0。

下一步先核查Analytics源基准/警告归因，保留阻断，不吞警告或暗改源码后标通过；全30映射、其余操作、当前依赖重绑定、生产接入和新全批模型/代码冻结仍待办，不直接付费全量或独立测试、不新增互操作或业务材料要求。

报告：`data/experiments/analysis/native_interaction_renamer_v1_20261115/REPORT.md`；说明：`docs/ir-design/native-interaction-renamer-v1.md`。以下只读检查，不启动浏览器、模型或Notebook UI。

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, re, runpy
root = next(p for p in [Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents] if (p/'migration_pipeline').is_dir() and (p/'notebooks').is_dir())
base = root/'data/experiments/analysis/native_interaction_renamer_v1_20261115'
read = lambda p: json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
lines = (base/'SHA256SUMS.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
for line in lines:
    pin, relative = line.split('  ', 1)
    p = (base/relative).resolve()
    assert p.is_relative_to(base.resolve()) and sha(p) == pin, relative
implementation = read(base/'implementation.json')
for path, record in implementation['files'].items():
    assert sha(root/path) == record['sha256']
    assert (root/path).read_text(encoding='utf-8') == record['frozen_source']
assert len(implementation['files']) == 7 and not implementation['production_prompt_rules_dispatch_changed']
reference = implementation['environment_reference']
assert sha(root/reference['path']) == reference['sha256']
assert not reference['complete_transitive_dependency_freeze'] and not reference['font_binary_pinned']
audit = runpy.run_path(str(root/'migration_pipeline/check_native_interaction_renamer_v1.py'))['audit']()
assert audit == read(base/'audit.json')
assert audit['renamer']['scenarios'] == 3 and audit['renamer']['paired_visual_checkpoints'] == 10
assert audit['renamer']['trusted_dom_events_final_total'] == 52
assert audit['renamer']['event_payload_distinct_from_current_files_at_emission']
assert audit['controls']['expected_negative'] == 3
assert not audit['production_ready'] and not audit['comprehensive_migration_pass']
assert audit['arbitrary_public_key_contract_preserved'] and audit['analytics_source_warning_still_blocks']
tests = read(base/'tests.json')
assert tests['successful'] and tests['tests'] == 249
assert sorted(r['tests'] for r in tests['reports']) == [12,23,25,46,53,90]
for row in tests['reports']:
    assert row['successful'] and row['failures'] == row['errors'] == row['skipped'] == 0
    assert int(re.search(r'Ran (\d+) tests',row['log'])[1]) == row['tests']
    assert re.search(r'\nOK\s*$',row['log'])
replay = read(base/'metric_replay.json')
assert replay['readOnly'] and replay['comparisonsRecomputed'] == len(replay['checks']) == 20
assert sum(c['kind']=='renamer' for c in replay['checks']) == 10
baseline = read(base/'baseline.json')
append = read(base/'notebook_append.json')
nb = read(root/baseline['notebook']['path'])
stable = lambda v: hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
assert stable(nb['cells'][:143]) == baseline['notebook']['cells_sha256']
assert stable(nb['metadata']) == baseline['notebook']['metadata_sha256']
assert nb['cells'][143:145] == append['cells']
scope = (root/'docs/ir-design/source-migration-scope-20261114.md').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(scope[:baseline['scope_prefix']['bytes']]).hexdigest() == baseline['scope_prefix']['sha256']
assert append['scope_append'] in scope.decode('utf-8')
print({'bounded_scenarios':3,'paired_visual_checkpoints':10,'control_pairs':4,'targeted_tests':249,'prior_payloads_unchanged':105,'model_calls':0,'production_ready':False,'old_batch':'unchanged 24/30','sealed_payloads':len(lines)})

scope_append: 2026-11-15（S2重命名原生交互）：BatchRenamer 三场景校准完成，见 `data/experiments/analysis/native_interaction_renamer_v1_20261115/REPORT.md`。另建 v2 原生 Ctrl+A/Input.insertText 动作、被动 payload 根身份观察及可选 DOM 集合，旧实现不改；schema5 不伪装接入旧反馈/生产。冻结默认三文件，编辑 img/3、隐藏恢复预览、编辑后应用，共6页14次原生输入，10对画面零像素/关键样式/矩形差，20单端语义检查一致；52个DOM事件isTrusted，apply载荷和currentFiles在发出时引用不同。另4对8页控制确认正常编辑通过、故意输出错误/源码警告/只读输入不通过，保留初始证据和not_run；20个可比PNG指标独立重算一致。最终249项定向测试通过（25+23+46+90+53+12，非全仓库），93旧相关文件、3人工配置、4参考、6冻结SFC、30对主Vue、上步105payload与closeout不变；Notebook只追加保留143单元与metadata，旧24/30及token1,821,544不变。仅默认可达交互校准，不豁免任意公开键、通知/异常等语义；Analytics源警告仍阻断，下一步核查其源端基准/警告后再推进其余场景，不吞警告或暗改源码。生产接入、全量场景/依赖绑定/全批冻结仍待办，无LLM/新增人工通过/commit/push，不新增互操作或业务材料要求。
